page_title: MAR 2-1 REI | Marseille v Reims 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' PENALTY APPEAL after Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90+6' A player from Reims commits a rough challenge. Eric Wattellier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+5' The ball is out of play and Reims manage to earn a corner.
90+4' Junya Ito (Reims) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Reims was in an offside position.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
88' Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
87' A lofted pass finds Junya Ito (Reims) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
84' Renan Lodi (Marseille) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
83' Amine Harit (Marseille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vitinha.
83' Substitution. Azzedine Ounahi makes his way off the pitch and Matteo Guendouzi (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
82' Vitinha picks out Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.
80' William Still prepares a substitution. Josh Wilson-Esbrand is replaced by Therence Koudou (Reims).
80' That's the end of the game for Marshall Munetsi, who is replaced by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
78' The ball goes behind for a corner. Reims will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

76' Vitinha (Marseille) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
76' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

73' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Vitinha (Marseille) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Ismaila Sarr. The score is now 2:1.
70' Junya Ito (Reims) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Valentin Rongier walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Veretout (Marseille).
67' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) replaces Iliman Ndiaye.
64' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) makes a strong challenge and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
63' Renan Lodi (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
60' Substitution. Amine Salama (Reims) has come on for Oumar Diakite.
60' William Still has decided to substitute Amir Richardson and he is replaced by Teddy Teuma (Reims).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Keito Nakamura (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Reda Khadra cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Renan Lodi (Marseille) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
58' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
57' The referee is firm and issues Amir Richardson (Reims) a deserved yellow card.

54' Yehvann Diouf doesn't have to worry about this one. Ismaila Sarr plays a pass into the feet of Vitinha (Marseille), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
53' One of the players from Reims times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
51' Francois Regis Mughe is substituted due to injury. Marcelino gives a chance to Ismaila Sarr (Marseille).
50' Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) picks up an injury.
50' It will be a corner kick for Reims.
46' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game. One of the players from Reims won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
46' The whistle blows and Eric Wattellier starts the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
45+1' The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
42' Marseille have a goal ruled out for offside!
41' After what seems an eternity, referee Eric Wattellier decides the ball went out of play after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Reims, play to continue.
40' The Reims players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
39' Goal! Amir Richardson passes the ball to Junya Ito (Reims) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Pau Lopez couldn't do anything about it. 1:2.
36' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
34' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul after Amir Richardson (Reims) hacks down one of his opponents.
32' Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Reims force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
26' The linesman makes the right call and Reims will have a corner.

23' 1 - 1 Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight inside the right post. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
20' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

19' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Marseille.
19' Marseille have a corner.
16' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner.
16' Reda Khadra (Reims) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
14' Marseille are ruled offside.
14' Another situation results in a direct free kick for Marseille.
10' 0 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Azor Matusiwa and Junya Ito (Reims) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:1.
8' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
7' The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
5' Reims fail to score from a corner as Pau Lopez (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
4' Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Eric Wattellier will supervise the game today.
